recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交（深藍黑色呈色、粉紅色核固紅襯染）：大量細胞核呈強的深藍黑色陽性訊號，大小不一、包含大型細胞，背景充滿粉紅色紅血球；germinotropic LPD 的特徵正是 HHV8 與 EBV 雙重感染，EBER 陽性是其與 HHV8 陽性 MCD 區分的關鍵。
features: Strong dark blue-black nuclear EBER signal in numerous cells
Positive nuclei range from medium to large, including large plasmablastic cells
Some large cells show weaker, granular nuclear signal
Pink counterstain with abundant background red blood cells (hemorrhagic area)
No cytoplasmic or extracellular non-specific signal
describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded small RNA (EBER), developed with a blue-black chromogen and pink counterstain, shows strong nuclear signal in numerous cells, including many large plasmablastic cells, with some large cells showing weaker granular signal. The background contains abundant red blood cells, and no non-specific cytoplasmic staining is present. EBV co-infection of the HHV8-positive plasmablasts is a defining feature of germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder. The findings support HHV8-positive, EBV-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder when correlated with HHV8 LANA-1 staining and germinal-center localization.

ddx.vs: The HHV8+ plasmablasts in MCD are EBER negative, whereas those in germinotropic LPD are EBER positive.
EBV+ DLBCL is HHV8 negative, expresses CD20/PAX5 and effaces the node in sheets.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is frequently EBER positive but HHV8 LANA-1 negative and forms diffuse effacing sheets.
